chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 354 – Lu Dongbin Accepts Yu Wei & Evergreen Chooses Ji Ning
chapter_meta_description: Lu Dongbin shocks the Immortal Fortunes Assembly by claiming Yu Wei as his disciple. As Ji Ning and Yu Wei face separation, the Xia Emperor visits the reclusive Evergreen Sword Immortal to arrange Ji Ning’s own mentorship.
og_title: The Eastflower Immortal Claims a Disciple
og_description: Lu Dongbin accepts Yu Wei at the Immortal Fortunes Assembly, while the Xia Emperor negotiates with a reclusive Pure Yang True Immortal for Ji Ning’s future.
twitter_title: Lu Dongbin snatches Yu Wei as his disciple in Desolate Era Ch. 354
twitter_description: A legendary Sword Immortal picks his pupil, and a cold-eyed True Immortal in a vegetable patch agrees to teach Ji Ning. Alliances and farewells tighten in this cultivation politics chapter.

lore_anchors.definition: The leader of the Eight Immortals of the Upper Cave in Chinese folklore. In *Desolate Era*, he is a legendary Pure Yang True Immortal and Sword Immortal known for his passionate teaching style and his willingness to accept even mortals as disciples.

A group of legendary Daoist immortals in Chinese mythology, each representing a different aspect of life and society. Lu Dongbin is their leader. In this novel, they are reimagined as top-tier True Immortals of the Three Realms.
The highest tier of Ki Refining cultivator below Daofather. A Pure Yang True Immortal has achieved a perfect, undecaying immortal body and wields immense authority in the Three Realms.

One of the supreme Daofathers of the Three Realms and the master of the Grand Xia Emperor. The Daofather personally oversees the selection of top talents from the Immortal Fortunes Assembly for his Crimsonbright lineage.

The cosmic mechanism that governs the cycle of death and rebirth across the Three Realms. Its collapse thirty-plus years ago is a sign of the coming great upheaval, a plot point that drives the selection of new heroes.

A Pure Yang True Immortal and a fiercely independent disciple of Daofather Crimsonbright. He lives as a simple farmer in a minor world temple, embodying the Xianxia philosophy that only one’s own power is reliable.

The faction of cultivators under Daofather Crimsonbright. The top three of the Immortal Fortunes Assembly are destined for this lineage, making it the most powerful patronage network in the Grand Xia world.
